claims.text: The source defines Imagic: (A) optimise target embedding toward an optimised embedding with denoising loss (Imagen 64px 100 steps lr 1e-3; SD latent 1000 steps lr 2e-3), (B) finetune UNet plus super-resolution stages fixing the optimised embedding (1500 steps), (C) interpolate eta 0.6-0.8 then generate plus super-resolve with 8 seeds picked best; preservation is background/structure/composition/identity for whole-image non-rigid edits.

Reported numbers: TEdBench 100 pairs, 9213 two-alternative answers, >70% preference over SDEdit/DDIB/Text2LIVE; eta 0.6-0.8 balances CLIP vs 1-LPIPS average over 150 inputs; cost ~8 min on 2xTPUv4 (Imagen) or 7 min on A100 (SD).
